system.description:
Battle Amp

While in this state, you gain the following benefits;

Hotter Still. You gain a +2 bonus to fire damage you deal. This increases to +4 at 7th and +6 at 15th levels

Fuel to the flame. When you deal Wind or Fire Damage to a creature with ranks of Burned, you convert 1 rank of Burned a creature has to 1 rank of Immolation.

Scorch Magnification. You can spend Scorch Charges to use the Scorch effect of Shakuton Hijutsu you cast.
system.summary: +2 fire damage (+4 at 7th, +6 at 15th). Wind or fire damage turns Burned into Immolation, and Scorch Charges fuel Scorch effects.

rules.text: You're in this state while you have Scorch Charges (they fade after 1 minute). From 15th (Scorching Dominion), always.
